cases.case_label: Alu insertion in exon 5 of GNPTAB
cases.mechanism_detail: The Alu insertion in exon 5 produced a transcript skipping exon 5 with frameshift p.S122fs and premature stop; disruption of exonic splicing enhancers is proposed. Compound heterozygous with c.2659dupA.
cases.quote: The Alu insertion mutation (NM_024312.3:c.555_556insHSU14569) generated a transcript with a skipping of the target exon 5 and a frameshift p.S122fs
